delivery.note: Send one HTML email to all recipients every morning after the briefing is researched and its state is updated.

economy_and_markets: interest rates, FX and capital markets
sector trends relevant to Indian and global business

prefer: official company investor relations, newsroom and filings
RBI, MOSPI, government and exchange releases
reputable Indian and international financial/business press
requirements: Cite the source URL for every item.
Deduplicate syndicated coverage into one underlying event.
Use publication/event dates and avoid stale recaps unless an update is material.
Do not treat job postings or anonymous reports as confirmed strategy.

brief_format.title: MBA Final Placements Briefing — <date>
item_fields: headline — one or two sentences on what happened
impact map — implications across strategy, finance/markets, operations/talent and customers, selecting only the affected dimensions
brief_format.length: 7–10 high-signal items, grouped by Economy & Markets, Companies & Strategy, and Industries, preceded by a 60-second executive read
brief_format.style: Substantive, factual, India-aware and executive-ready. Use a visually scannable HTML-email layout when delivery is enabled: navy hero banner, short executive-summary block, section headers, rounded item cards, two-column impact maps, readable type scale and inline CSS only. Clearly label interpretation versus reported fact.

source_failures.reason: Direct page extraction timed out. Search-result text was available; these URLs should be retried next run.
